- **Where it came from:** Ilse Varga posted it in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55. I checked first that Dana is a member of that channel. GBrain had the same exchange, and the channel itself confirmed it.

- **Ticket status:** I couldn't confirm it. #help-it-ops has no messages, so I told Dana I can't say whether the ticket is still open.
